purpose: hand-check of dated pages that are not evidence for the baseline entry; not approvals

tet.note: Tết Masses are out of scope (owner, 2026-11-11); the page prints a Tết or year-end Mass, or the 2026 transferred Ash Mass.

martyrs_external.note: Page prints the Vietnamese Martyrs Gospel (Lc 9,23-26) on Sunday XXXIII or the day after Christ the King; the owner keeps Sunday XXXIII and the November 24 rule.

optional.note: Page follows an optional memorial, a memorial's optional proper Gospel, or an external solemnity; owner policy keeps the ordinary day.

other.2022-04-12: Typo on the page: Ga 13,21-33.36-3 for 36-38.
other.2021-05-10: Page prints Ga 15,26-16,4 without the part letter; other years print 4a.
other.2022-01-06: Page prints Lc 4,14-22 without the part letter; other years print 22a.
other.2022-06-23: Page prints the Nativity of John the Baptist, anticipated to June 23 in 2022 because June 24 was the Sacred Heart; the provider leaves June 23 a weekday.
other.2025-11-02: All Souls fell on Sunday; the page prints the Sunday XXXI Gospel.
other.2026-09-25: Page prints the Mid-Autumn (Tết Trung Thu) Mass, a lunar-date Vietnamese Mass like Tết; the ordinary day is kept. The 2026 ledger accepted the page's Gospel for this date.
other.2023-08-07: Transfiguration replaced Sunday XVIII in 2023, so Monday kept Mt 14,13-21 although the year was A.
other.2023-12-24: Page prints the Christmas night Mass (Lc 2,1-14) on the Fourth Sunday of Advent.

page_read.note: Reference printed on the page but rejected by the importer; read by hand.

conditional.note: Real lectionary rules that depend on the Sunday cycle; entries get a cycle-specific key.

temporal:lent_5_monday.why: Year C reads Ga 8,1-11 on the Sunday before.

temporal:easter_time_4_monday.why: Year A reads Ga 10,1-10 on the Sunday before.

temporal:ordinary_time_18_monday.why: Year A reads Mt 14,13-21 on the Sunday before. Applies only when Sunday XVIII is actually celebrated (not in 2023, when August 6 was that Sunday).

temporal:ordinary_time_18_tuesday.why: Follows the Monday rule in Year A.

decisions.note: Entries set by owner policy rather than by page majority.

observance:nativity_of_the_lord.why: Daytime Mass (owner policy). Pages printed the dawn Mass (Lc 2,15-20) in 2021, 2022 and 2025 and the day Mass in 2023 and 2024.

observance:timothy_of_ephesus_and_titus_.why: Proper Gospel: 2024 and 2026 pages and the reviewed 2026 date (two Vietnamese calendars). 2022 and 2023 pages printed the weekday.

observance:our_lady_of_the_rosary.why: Proper Gospel on five of six pages and the reviewed 2026 date; the 2021 page printed the weekday.

observance:mary_mother_of_the_church.why: Reviewed 2026 date (individual review). Four pages print Ga 19,25-27 and two print the weekday. Open: pages and review differ on the last verse.

observance:presentation_of_the_lord.why: First-listed full option (owner policy): three pages print the full form. The 2026 page and reviewed date use the short form Lc 2,22-32. Open for the owner.

observance:nativity_of_the_blessed_virgi.why: First-listed full option (owner policy): four pages print the full form. The 2026 page and reviewed date use the short form Mt 1,18-23. Open for the owner.

temporal:ordinary_time_6_sunday:YEAR_A.why: Full form: 2023 page and reviewed 2026 date; the 2026 page prints the short form.

temporal:ordinary_time_18_sunday:YEAR_A.why: Reviewed 2026 date (two calendars); the 2026 page prints no reference and 2023 was displaced by the Transfiguration.
